create_OssTensorboardLogger: create an OssTensorboardLogger instance with a save directory and optional name for PyTorch Lightning training
log_metrics_OssTensorboardLogger: log a dictionary of scalar metrics or nested metric dicts to the OssTensorboardLogger with an optional step
clear_local_data_OssTensorboardLogger: clear the in-memory line plot buffer and aggregated plot data from the OssTensorboardLogger
store_metrics_LocalCacheLogger: store metrics into a TensorBoard logger's line plot buffer using LocalCacheLogger for in-memory caching
add_point_LocalCacheLogger: add a single data point to a multi-line plot in the logger's buffer with an optional x coordinate
